subject: Holton and Manning Street Demolition Delays
overview: The commission invoked 18-month demolition delays for properties on Holton and Manning Streets while declining to protect a fire-damaged structure on Alfred Street. Members also approved a new policy to fast-track the review of minor outbuildings and discussed the intersection of historic preservation with proposed city zoning changes.

items.title: 47 Holton Street Public Hearing
items.summary: Approved preferably preserved status for the property, finding the architectural details and neighborhood integration worthy of an 18-month demolition delay.

items.title: 16 Manning Street Public Hearing
items.summary: Approved preferably preserved status following extensive public testimony and a 44-signature petition supporting the building's historical role in the neighborhood.

items.title: 26 Alfred Street Determination of Significance
items.summary: Declined to find the property significant due to extensive fire damage and the owner's testimony regarding structural instability, allowing demolition to proceed.

items.title: Infrastructure and Cemetery Projects
items.summary: Supported a stormwater and road assessment at Oak Grove Cemetery and a Mystic River Watershed Association project to assess local bridges for future restoration.

items.title: Legislative and Zoning Discussion
items.summary: Reviewed concerns regarding State House Bill 993 and established a subcommittee to provide comments on the city's proposed zoning changes by the upcoming deadline.

items.title: Preservation Ordinance Policy Changes
items.summary: Approved a motion empowering the subcommittee to fast-track applications for minor outbuildings like sheds and modern garages to streamline the permitting process.

items.title: Automatic Significance Proposal
items.summary: Tabled a proposal to automatically designate all pre-1900 buildings as significant to allow for a broader discussion involving the full commission.

items.title: CPC and Survey Updates
items.summary: Discussed emergency funding for the Armory building and potential Community Preservation Act funding to create a searchable digital database for city historical surveys.

items.title: Administrative Business
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from May and June and voted to remove the Historical District Commission liaison report from future agendas.
